literal_meaning: এক-এক (one by one or each one)
figurative_meaning_en: Each one, emphasizing individuality or variety in a reduplicative sense
similar_in_english: Variety is the spice of life
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার একেক ছেলে একেক রকমের প্রকৃতি।
example_sentences_in_english: Each of his sons has a different personality.
Every year brings a different yield of crops.
note: This idiom uses reduplication, a common linguistic feature in Bengali to denote distribution or variation.
